titolo: SpaceXSI releases Grok Bot 1.0.0 with upcoming Teams, Discord and texting features
descr: SpaceXSI makes its autonomous AI teammate Grok Bot 1.0.0 available for download, previewing integration with Microsoft Teams, Discord and native messaging.
paragrafi: The bot already works with Slack and can trigger routines from Teams messages, while a dedicated Tasks tab is being built to show ongoing processes outside chat.
Developers have spotted a new Texting tab in Settings that includes permissions for the bot to read and send text messages, hinting at future iMessage or RCS support.
Early indications also show Discord integration is under exploration, allowing users to add a Discord bot token and receive replies in servers and DMs.
Grok Bot is offered in beta for SuperGrok, SuperGrok Plus, SuperGrok Heavy, Cursor Pro tiers and Cursor Teams subscribers on desktop and iOS, with separate usage limits from existing plans.
perche: For AI users, Grok Bot provides a cloud‑based teammate that can act across apps without requiring custom workflows, potentially speeding up routine tasks. Those preferring free or locally hosted models may view Grok Bot as a commercial alternative that leverages cloud resources rather than on‑device inference.
